# engine_cpp — deterministic C++ engine core, M1 (task-4).
# C++20, CTest; byte/sequence parity against engine/crates/core +
# rts-game/crates/shared via testdata/*.json generated by the Rust oracle in
# tools/dump_vectors.rs (see tools/run_dump.sh).
cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(engine_cpp VERSION 0.1.0 LANGUAGES CXX)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)
set(CMAKE_EXPORT_COMPILE_COMMANDS ON)

if(NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE)
  set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE RelWithDebInfo)
endif()

add_library(engine_core_cpp STATIC src/engine.cpp)
target_include_directories(engine_core_cpp PUBLIC include)
if(CMAKE_CXX_COMPILER_ID MATCHES "GNU|Clang")
  target_compile_options(engine_core_cpp PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
endif()

enable_testing()

add_test(NAME grep_gate_no_float_no_banned
  COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -P ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/tools/grep_gate.cmake)

set(TESTDATA ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/testdata)

foreach(name IN ITEMS
    rng_parity hash_parity fnv_parity fixed_parity isqrt_parity
    scheduler_parity replay_parity command_parity event_tick_parity
    self_contained_parity)
  add_executable(${name} test/${name}.cpp)
  target_include_directories(${name} PRIVATE test/include include test)
  target_link_libraries(${name} PRIVATE engine_core_cpp)
  target_compile_options(${name} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra)
  add_test(NAME ${name} COMMAND ${name} ${TESTDATA})
endforeach()
